sources.title: Clip Studio Paint product lineup (search snippet only)

keyLimits.en: Introductory subscription price starting at $0.99/month (first period); works across iPad, Android, Windows, macOS, iPhone; includes 10GB cloud storage and monthly bonus materials.
Windows/macOS only. Includes brushes, 3D models, comic tools, up to 24 animation frames. Pay once, use forever; separate Update Pass needed for ongoing new features.
Windows/macOS only. Adds unlimited animation frames, multi-page project management, line extraction from images. Can be purchased as an upgrade from PRO for the price difference.

addOns.en: GOLD in-app currency for purchasing materials, roughly $1 USD per 100 GOLD.
Update Pass (annual renewal) for perpetual license holders to keep receiving new features.

cautions.en: Perpetual (one-time) licenses are Windows/macOS only; iPad, Android, Galaxy and Chromebook require a subscription.
The $0.99/month subscription price is an introductory rate for a limited period, not the ongoing price; the page did not display the regular recurring subscription price clearly in this session.

capabilities.en: Drawing, illustration, comics/manga and animation tool with pressure-sensitive brush engine.
Dedicated comic/manga page layout and multi-page project management (EX tier).
Frame-by-frame animation support, with a 24-frame cap on PRO and unlimited frames on EX.

limitations.en: Multi-page comic management and unlimited animation frames require the more expensive EX tier.
Perpetual license does not include ongoing feature updates without purchasing a separate Update Pass.

reason.en: Popular iPad-first illustration app frequently compared for digital painting workflows.
Free, open-source painting/illustration tool covering similar drawing and animation use cases.
Adobe's illustration/painting app competing for the same digital art audience.
General-purpose raster tool used for illustration by some of the same audience.

unknowns: Exact regular (non-introductory) subscription price per month could not be confirmed on the official page in this session.
Whether the 12-month license codes noted as 'temporarily unavailable' have since returned was not checked further to respect the page budget.
